items.title: Equivalence partitioning
items.body:
Rule: age 18-65 can register.
Partitions:  invalid (<18)   valid (18-65)   invalid (>65)   invalid (non-numeric / empty)
Test one value from each:  10,  30,  80,  "abc",  (blank)
items.description: Split inputs into classes that should behave the same, test one from each.

items.title: Boundary value analysis
items.body:
Rule: quantity must be 1 to 100.
Test: 0, 1, 2, 99, 100, 101
(Two-value version: 0, 1, 100, 101.)
For floats or dates, use the smallest step: 0.99, 1.00, 100.00, 100.01
items.description: Test at and next to each boundary, where bugs cluster.

items.title: Decision table
items.body:
Rule: free shipping if member AND order >= 50; 10% off if coupon.

Conditions        R1  R2  R3  R4
Is member          Y   Y   N   N
Order >= 50        Y   N   Y   N
Has coupon         Y   Y   N   N
Actions
Free shipping      X       .   .
10% discount       X   X   .   .
(Fill every combination: 2^n columns, then merge identical outcomes.)
items.description: All combinations of conditions with the expected action.

items.title: State transition testing
items.body:
States: Draft -> Submitted -> Approved / Rejected -> (Closed)
Test: each valid transition, each invalid one (e.g. Draft -> Approved must be refused),
repeated transitions, and what happens on refresh or double-click.
items.description: Test every transition, including invalid ones.

items.title: Pairwise (all-pairs) testing
items.body:
Parameters: Browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), OS (Win, Mac, Linux), Language (EN, DE)
Full combinations: 3 x 3 x 2 = 18. Pairwise covers all pairs in about 9.
Tools: PICT (Microsoft), allpairspy (Python): pip install allpairspy
items.description: Cover every pair of values without every combination.

items.title: Test-case template
items.body:
ID:            TC-LOGIN-001
Title:         Login succeeds with valid credentials
Requirement:   REQ-12 (traceability)
Priority:      High
Preconditions: User "ada" exists and is active
Test data:     username = ada, password = correct-horse
Steps:
  1. Open the login page
  2. Enter username and password
  3. Press "Log in"
Expected:      Dashboard opens; "Welcome, ada" is shown
Actual:        (filled in during execution)
Status:        Pass / Fail / Blocked
Notes:
items.description: Fields every written test case needs.

items.title: Test-case naming convention
items.body:
TC-<AREA>-<NNN>        e.g. TC-LOGIN-001, TC-CART-014
Title pattern:         <Action> <object> <condition>  ->  "Reject login with expired password"
Group by feature, not by tester.

items.title: Negative input list
items.body:
[ ] Empty and whitespace only
[ ] Very long string (255, 1000, 100000 characters)
[ ] Leading and trailing spaces
[ ] Special characters: ' " < > & % \ / ;
[ ] Unicode, emoji and right-to-left text
[ ] Script and SQL-like strings (only on systems you are allowed to test)
[ ] Numbers where text is expected and the reverse
[ ] Negative, zero, decimal and huge numbers
[ ] Duplicate of an existing value
[ ] Copy-pasted text with line breaks
items.description: Inputs to try on any text field.

items.title: Date and time test ideas
items.body:
[ ] Today, yesterday, tomorrow
[ ] Leap day (29 Feb) and year end (31 Dec to 1 Jan)
[ ] Month lengths (30, 31) and February
[ ] Time zones and daylight saving changes
[ ] Midnight (00:00) and 23:59
[ ] Start date after end date
[ ] Very old and far-future dates
[ ] Different date formats and locales

items.title: Error guessing prompts
items.body:
- What happens if I do it twice, quickly (double-click / retry)?
- What if the network drops halfway?
- What if the data is missing, deleted or changed by someone else?
- What if I go back, refresh or open it in two tabs?
- What if the disk, memory or quota is full?
- What would a malicious user try?
items.description: Questions that lead to extra test ideas.

items.title: Requirement traceability matrix
items.body:
| Requirement | Description          | Test cases           | Status |
|-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------|
| REQ-01      | User can log in      | TC-LOGIN-001..004    | Pass   |
| REQ-02      | Password reset email | TC-RESET-001..003    | Fail   |
items.description: Link requirements to tests so nothing is untested.

items.title: Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then)
items.body:
Given I am a logged-in customer with items in my cart
When I press "Checkout" and my payment is declined
Then I see "Payment failed" and my cart is unchanged
items.description: Behaviour-style criteria that become test cases.

items.title: Test report summary
Usability heuristics (Nielsen)
items.body:
1 Visibility of system status    2 Match with the real world
3 User control and freedom       4 Consistency and standards
5 Error prevention               6 Recognition rather than recall
7 Flexibility and efficiency     8 Minimalist design
9 Help users recover from errors 10 Help and documentation
items.description: Ten checks for a user interface review.

items.title: Mobile test matrix ideas
items.body:
Android versions (oldest supported to newest) x screen sizes (small phone, large phone, tablet)
Orientation (portrait/landscape), dark mode, font size scale, language/RTL
Interrupts: incoming call, notification, app switch, low battery, airplane mode
Install, upgrade over previous version (data kept), uninstall
